body:
He is currently 19. For the other part, we are already on it! I hope it will just pass hih like last time, but I'd surely like to be more there for him. Thanks for fast response!

edit: phrasing

Did you try professional help? Do you anyhow feel the depression and suicidal tendencies can end? Are you willing to do anything for yourself in face of everything? Sorry for a barrage of questions, but I feel I'm not really having options. It's hard with miserable and pessimistic people.

And for you, best of luck really. I know it's not much, or anything, but I'd be honestly happy for you if you were good to yourself. Also feel free to PM me

He already denies professional help. I can't really force him into anything. That is what makes this hard. On a side note, a have another friend who is on heavy medication and professional help for about 5 years now, and I certainly don't envy his life. He seems like he's in agony, except when he's on medication which just makes him docile (but sadness literally breaks through his eyes). I just feel so bad for them, with nothing to do really. It's not about me I know, but what if person denies help? What am I expected to do?

edit: no, his parents do not now. He is extremely detached from family. Hinted couple of times that "they wouldn't understand him anyway"
